title: Using the library
description:
Write these in `solution.c`, each built on the standard library function named:

```c
void sort_ints(int *values, size_t count);                       /* qsort, smallest first */
const int *find_sorted(const int *values, size_t count, int key);/* bsearch on a sorted array; NULL if absent */
int sum_all(int count, ...);                                     /* stdarg.h: adds count ints */
void format_date(char *out, size_t size, int year, int month, int day);   /* snprintf: "2024-03-07" */
void remove_at(char *s, size_t index);                           /* memmove: deletes one character */
```
hints: `qsort` needs a comparison function taking two `const void *`: cast them to `const int *` and return -1, 0 or 1 (avoid `a - b`, which can overflow).
`bsearch` uses the same comparison and returns `NULL` when the key is absent. For `format_date`, `snprintf(out, size, "%04d-%02d-%02d", ...)`.
rules: Read the extra arguments with va_arg.

rules.message: Read the extra arguments with va_arg.
